name: write_running_sums_in_pairs

name: skip_records_until_negative

name: zero_record_table_with_tag

name: repeat_calls_while_negative_entry

name: pack_sprite_position_words

name: initialize_record_list_buffer

name: mask_status_conditional_limit

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, with no logic of its own.

name: store_char_in_ring_buffer

name: copy_escaped_text_fragment

name: copy_asterisk_terminated_string

name: update_timed_input_state

name: step_through_pending_entries

name: spin_sixteen_bit_delay

name: clear_buffer_words_and_tail

name: store_seven_bit_value

name: call_four_routines_while_negative

name: set_error_flag_and_tag

name: compare_long_sequences

name: load_table_entry_into_state

name: assign_slot_base_addresses

name: repeat_calls_while_negative_entry

name: fill_buffer_until_count_zero

name: spin_down_input_count

name: forward_call_preserving_registers
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns the two result registers it left, passing them through unchanged.

name: sum_glyph_widths_until_byte
description: Walks a byte string until it reaches a given terminator byte, adding each character's width from a width table plus one to a running total, and returns that total.

name: format_signed_number_digits
description: Converts a signed 16-bit value to its absolute value, writes its five decimal digits as characters into a fixed buffer, and returns a state word.

name: write_signed_number_digits
description: Converts a signed 16-bit value to its absolute value and writes its five decimal digits as characters into a fixed buffer.

name: write_long_number_digits
description: Writes the absolute value of a 32-bit signed number as its last five decimal digits into a fixed buffer.

name: write_signed_number_digits
description: Converts a signed 16-bit value to its absolute value and writes its five decimal digits as characters into a fixed buffer.

name: convert_digit_string_to_value
description: Sets a flag bit in the state block, then converts a string of decimal digit characters into a number by weighting each digit with a value from a table.

name: update_input_state_flags
description: Copies a masked status word into a state word, then, depending on which flag bits remain set, calls unnamed routines, decrements two counters and dispatches through a stored handler pointer.

name: dispatch_active_handler
description: Calls one of two handlers held in a dispatch table, chosen by the top bit of a state byte, and returns the handler's result, or the all-ones value when neither bit is set.

name: update_timed_input_state
description: Runs one update tick: calls an unnamed routine, advances a counter when a state bit is set and a limit check passes, runs a sub-routine, and calls an unnamed routine on the rising edge of a latch bit in a state byte.

name: read_controller_and_clamp_position
description: Reads the controller input port bits into a direction code, moves two position words by the change in the readings and clamps them between zero and per-axis limits, then packs button and direction bits into a state byte.

name: step_through_pending_entries
description: Reads entries from a pointer-driven list, counting each down and advancing to the next when its count is exhausted, calls unnamed routines for entries whose top bit is clear, and stores the first entry with that bit set in the state block before a short countdown delay.

name: spin_sixteen_bit_delay
description: Spins a 16-bit counter through a full cycle, creating a short fixed delay.

name: clear_state_flag_bit
description: Clears a single flag bit in a state byte.

name: write_pixel_pattern_and_update
description: Writes a longword pattern into four byte slots spaced two apart, loads state words from a table selected by the input, and when a table flag is set, updates a state bit and copies a set of counters and positions into the state block.

name: advance_position_counters
description: Decrements a state byte counter, copies a set of counters and positions from the state block into the working block, advances two position values and sets a flag word.

name: check_bounds_and_setup_segment
description: Checks that an input position lies inside the state block's bounds, stores a derived offset and count, and calls an unnamed routine to set up the segment; returns zero when a segment was set up, otherwise the all-ones value.

name: setup_segment_from_inputs
description: Stores derived offset and width values from its inputs into the state block, computes a counted sum of the row stride, and calls an unnamed routine to set up the segment; returns zero when a segment is set up, otherwise the all-ones value.

name: split_value_count_and_mask
description: Splits an input value into a doubled count taken from its upper bits and a bit mask derived from its lower bits, stores the mask and shifted values in the state block, and returns the count.

name: store_mask_and_return_count
description: Stores a value from the caller in the state block and returns the input shifted right by four bits and doubled.

name: start_channel_with_busy_lock
description: Waits for a busy bit in the state block to clear while setting it, installs a handler pointer and initialises a set of words in an associated block from state values.

name: start_channel_then_await_release
description: Acquires the busy bit by spinning until it is clear, installs a handler, initialises a block of words from state values with a different fixed value, then spins until the busy bit is clear again.

name: clear_buffer_words_and_tail
description: Zeroes a buffer of 16-bit words, with the word count taken as half the input value, and clears one extra byte when the input is odd.

name: call_four_routines_while_negative
description: Calls four unnamed routines in sequence and repeats the sequence for as long as the negative condition flag left by the previous pass remains set.

name: set_error_flag_and_tag
description: Sets a flag bit in a state byte, writes a fixed four-byte error marker to a global pointer, calls two unnamed routines, clears a second flag bit and returns zero.

name: compare_long_sequences
description: Compares two sequences of 32-bit words for the given count, returning zero when all words match and the all-ones value at the first mismatch.

name: load_table_entry_into_state
description: Stores its inputs in the state block, then looks up a 32-byte table entry by index, copying a shifted word and a byte from that entry into the state block and returning a word from the entry.

name: assign_slot_base_addresses
description: Walks up to fifteen slot records, clearing a request flag in each; for requested slots it calls an unnamed routine, stores the running base address in the slot's pointer table and advances the base by a stride, stopping once the base passes a fixed limit.

name: repeat_calls_while_negative_entry
description: Repeats a pair of unnamed routine calls while a negative value looked up from a table by an index and a status bit both remain set, then returns zero.

name: repeat_calls_while_negative_entry
description: Repeats a pair of unnamed routine calls while a negative value looked up from a table by an index and a status bit both remain set, then returns zero.

name: call_two_constant_return_routines
description: Calls two tiny unnamed routines that each return a constant, zero and then the all-ones value; the full logic of this entry could not be recovered.

name: copy_or_draw_table_segment
description: If a state flag is set, copies a counted run of longs from a source table into the destination; otherwise it wraps a column coordinate at eighty and calls an unnamed routine with the adjusted coordinates to draw the segment.

name: scan_rows_or_run_handlers
description: Saves its arguments, then either writes six row-select patterns to an input port and returns, or runs repeated handler calls over a counted span, and clears a table of 4096 words once the counted loop finishes.

name: write_row_select_patterns
description: Writes six fixed row-select patterns to an input port in sequence, ending on the idle pattern.

name: call_three_routines_in_order
description: Calls three unnamed routines in sequence.

name: wait_while_port_bit_set
description: Waits while bit five of an input port byte stays set, counting down from a 16-bit value and returning when the bit clears or the count runs out.

name: select_port_mask_from_flag
description: Sets a state byte to one of two fixed mask values based on a flag, then writes the complement of that mask, limited to seven bits, to a hardware port.
